q1_issues.issue: "was isolated for 80 million years" functions as a durative predicate-adjective state (no agent, stative for-duration), which the instruction set routes as a copular clause — a reified state with Experiencer plus the flat (Past (Member new_zealand isolated)) — whereas the parse reifies an agentless passive isolating event.

notes: Even under the passive-event reading the role test is doubtful: isolating neither creates, destroys nor physically changes New Zealand, so the "when the test is unclear, default to Theme" rule would favour Theme over Patient. The duration atom itself is well-formed (native magnitude, lemmatized singular unit) and the multi-word name plus its single Name fact are correct.
